name: DoctorSchedule
description: A doctor's defined availability for appointments.

attributes.name: idOfUser
attributes.description: Owning doctor — set automatically on create from the authenticated user; only the owning doctor or an admin may update or delete their schedule.

attributes.name: doctorId
attributes.description: The doctor whose schedule this entry represents.

attributes.name: scheduleDate
attributes.description: The date for which this schedule entry applies.

attributes.name: startTime
attributes.description: The start time of the doctor's availability (e.g., '09:00').

attributes.name: endTime
attributes.description: The end time of the doctor's availability (e.g., '17:00').

attributes.name: isAvailable
attributes.description: Indicates if the doctor is available for appointments during this period.

attributes.name: breakStartTime
attributes.description: The start time of a break within the availability period.

attributes.name: breakEndTime
attributes.description: The end time of a break within the availability period.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes or details about the schedule entry.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The status of the schedule entry (e.g., active, holiday).
